title: Anomaly Detection Sandbox
summary: Synthetic 2D dataset with three anomaly scoring heuristics (z-score, isolation radius, autoencoder-style error) and live threshold visualisation.

vr_notes.comfort: Static environment; only point scaling animates when thresholds change.
vr_notes.interaction: Helper methods can be bound to VR controls for mode switching and reseeding.
vr_notes.performance: <100 MeshInstance3D nodes and one translucent disc; trivial on desktop standalone.

parameters.name: isolation_radius_threshold
parameters.description: Radius cutoff for the isolation heuristic.

parameters.name: autoencoder_error_threshold
parameters.description: Accepted reconstruction error before flagging anomalies.

parameters.name: anomaly_scale_multiplier
parameters.description: Visual scale boost applied to flagged points.
